review.notes: Full review. Sampled targets 1.1-2.6 and all four headline theorems recomputed (adversarial table, 16 rows); all 29 Checks and the worked examples recomputed and true. 195 cited library names elaborated by #check at the pins; the 13 in two unbuilt Tau Ceti modules read in source. Suggested.lean elaborates with no error or warning. Automatic checks re-run: all pass, including the targeted build; depcheck 0 problems. Sources: none of the 5 references readable legally (Bhatia, Marshall-Olkin-Arnold, Mirsky paywalled; Fan 1949 PMC copy refused; Schur 1923 not found), so no locator was verified against its text. Main correction: the old MAJ labels are dropped with no old-to-new map, and 3 roadmaps on main plus 3 open ones cite them.
